assets.caption: FIGURE 3   TYPICAL SET PRESSURES FOR PRESSURE SAFETY RELIEF (GAS LINE)
assets.description: Diagram with three columns: Pipeline requirements (left; MAIP, MAOP, MOP), Pipeline pressure (centre; vertical axis labelled 'Pressure in percentage of MAOP'), and Set pressures (right). Tick marks at 110, 100, 95, 94, and 91 percent MAOP with labels: 110 = full PSV relief; 100 = set pressure PSV; 95 = set pressure PRA(H); 94 = reseat pressure PSV; 91 = set pressure control. Note below figure: 'Above is typical only – see (2.4) for exceptions.'
